name: End-to-End Verification, Pre-flight Checks & Minor Release Ceremony
requirements: Run cargo fmt -- --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features
Run npm run build to verify zero TypeScript/Vite compilation errors
Execute minor version bump: npm run bump minor (v4.128.1 -> v4.129.0)
Update changelogs and sync READMEs attributing strictly @aukgit
Commit, tag v4.129.0, push to main, and monitor GitHub Actions CI release until green
